{{Top|leg}}
'''Blackstrap gloves''' were heavy duty [[Glove/Legends|gloves]] that were part of the standard raiment of the [[Morellian Enforcers]]. [[Barosa Warren]] still wore them even after his retirement from the Enforcers, along with the rest of the iconic attire.<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>
